about_the_game:
Coins, Crown & Cabal is an economic and political trade simulation set in medieval Europe.
Build a trade empire by amassing wealth, influence and power, facing tough social and political decisions. Gain the nobility’s favor, stay ahead of your rivals and become the dominant commercial force in your county.

Build your medieval trade city

  • Invest your funds to build and improve amenities, work and living spaces for the settlers in your village and shape it into your ideal flourishing trade city
  • Produce raw materials and refine them into quality goods to increase the value of your future merchandise
  • Learn about your workers’ strengths, weaknesses and worries while treating them to a drink, harness your knowledge and their trust to use them to their full potential

Deal with fellow players

  • Send dedicated trade convoys to neighboring villages, buy goods your village needs to prosper and sell off the wares you can spare
  • Keep distance, terrain and potential bandit ambushes in mind and establish secure and optimal trade routes
  • Influence the player-based economy in your county to your advantage and stay ahead of your competitors

Conspire in political machinations

  • Gain the current nobility's favor, occupy seats in various councils and increase your political influence
  • Fulfill missions bestowed upon you by the Count or even the King himself – but be careful, those who blunder in matters of intrigue will face the consequences of their failures
  • Engage in a variety of political or social events and carefully consider your decisions, for they carry weight… and the scales not always tip in your favor

  • Processor: Intel i5 3470, AMD FX 6350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 670 GTX or AMD Radeon R9 285 (2 GB of VRAM, Shader Model 5.0)

  • Storage: 5 GB available space
